settings.question: What's the difference between Closed Sole and Open Sole?
settings.answer: Closed Sole — heel and foot fully covered. Open Sole — heel exposed, mid-foot breathing hole. More grounded, barefoot feel. Natural toe splay. Both perform identically — same grip, same stability. Choice is preference and feel only. Same $74.

settings.question: Tired of Pilates socks and yoga socks that slip?
settings.answer: Pilates socks, yoga socks, and barre grip socks rely on silicone dots that peel and fabric that stretches. Performance Skins replace that category with full-underfoot grippy shoes — Secure in Every Hold through flat back chair, water ski, chair pose, reformer footwork series, and Megaformer Super Lunge — without mid-set resets. Not another disposable sock.

settings.question: Best alternative to Pilates socks, yoga socks & barre grip socks?
settings.answer: Yes — that's the job. Traditional barre grip socks and Pilates socks absorb sweat and lose traction in weeks. One Performance Skin pair (Closed Sole or Open Sole, $74) holds through footwork series, water ski, Super Lunge, Catfish, and heated rooms without the sock-replacement cycle. Full-contact 360° grip instead of dots — built for barre, Classical and reformer Pilates, Cadillac, Megaformer, Lagree, yoga, and hot Pilates. Both soles perform identically — same grip, same stability.

settings.question: Which machines and disciplines are they built for?
settings.answer: Barre, mat Pilates, Classical Pilates, reformer, Cadillac (trapeze table), Chair, Tower, Megaformer, Lagree, yoga, hot yoga, and hot Pilates. Same 360° grip whether you're on the carriage, holding the Cadillac bar (parakeet / push-through), digging into Super Lunges on Megaformer, or flowing on the mat. Closed Sole and Open Sole both perform identically across every discipline — choice is preference and feel only.

settings.question: Reformer, Cadillac, Chair & Tower — will they hold on Classical apparatus?
settings.answer: Yes. On the reformer: footwork series (toes, arches, heels, tendon stretch), elephant, knee stretches, and the long stretch series demand continuous underfoot contact. On the Cadillac / trapeze table: push-through and parakeet need grip that holds the bar — not a sock that slides off mid-exercise. Bridging and footwork on the Chair or reformer stay locked without sock resets. Same grip system in Closed Sole or Open Sole.

settings.question: Megaformer, Lagree & barre — named moves that punish grip socks?
settings.answer: Megaformer and Lagree: Super Lunge, Elevator Lunge, Catfish, Bear, and Plank to Pike load the foot laterally — silicone-dot socks slide. At the barre: flat back chair, water ski, relevé, plié, and seat-work pulses need feet that don't walk out of the hold. Same 360° grip system in every color above.

settings.question: Can I wear a sock with them?
settings.answer: Yes. Optional. A sock made for Performance Skins with grip around the toes — for sweat, warmth, comfort, or when the studio wants a sock. The Skin is still the grip. Both soles perform identically — same grip, same stability. Choice is preference and feel only.

settings.question: Yoga flows — chair pose to downward dog?
settings.answer: From chair pose (Utkatasana) and warrior to downward dog and standing balances — grip that holds through every transition. Closed Sole or Open Sole — same $74 system as barre and Pilates. Both perform identically — same grip, same stability. Choice is preference and feel only.
